## Error handler (shared by all three workflows)
Any failed run lands here. The ledger row of that run is set to **failed**, so a redelivery of the same event runs again instead of being treated as a duplicate. An alert with ids only (workflow, node, execution, key; never the payload) goes to the chat channel.

parameters.query:
UPDATE idempotency_keys
   SET status = 'failed', error = $2, updated_at = now()
 WHERE execution_id = $1 AND status = 'processing'
RETURNING workflow, key, attempts;

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ kind: 'workflow_error', workflow: $('Error details').first().json.workflow, node: $('Error details').first().json.node, execution_id: $('Error details').first().json.execution_id, message: $('Error details').first().json.message, ledger_workflow: $json.workflow || null, key: $json.key || null, released: Boolean($json.key) }) }}
